title.zh: 双路通商：货单抵达

desc.zh: 商队要求南北两路同时护送，关卡官争论税款归属。
desc.en: Caravans demand escorts on both roads as checkpoints dispute tolls.

cost_note.zh: 双倍周费；需双向接入且与两国关系达中立。
cost_note.en: Double weekly fee; requires both relations neutral-or-better.

consequence_note.zh: 付双份护路费，失败付款不得推进。 路线签署会带来两年期集团支持变化，且按路线产生不同国库支出。
consequence_note.en: Changes the negotiation state; grants no treaty, protection or income. Signing also shifts interest-group approval for two years and charges a route-specific treasury cost.
